title: Answer: seeing without recurrence, or content tracking prefrontal cortex

statements.text: The theory would be weakened by conscious seeing with recurrent processing disrupted and only the feedforward sweep intact, by unaccessed items in partial report that prove to involve no recurrence, or by conscious content that tracks prefrontal rather than visual cortex.

sources.quote: more posterior >110 msec activity is (at least) a necessary condition for awareness to arise
the representations of the unaccessed items will prove to involve recurrent loops
